status: Standalone APT backend candidate; not wired to public system updates and not a complete system update integration
implemented: Trusted absolute command paths and optional privilege/env argv capability; controlled locale/noninteractive env, no shell
Initialization, actual package query, refresh, exact escaped resolution, install and upgrade
Cached defensive status, serialized operations, failed refresh retains prior successful snapshot/time
Required injected durable mutation journal; pending before dispatch, known non-dispatch clears intent, ambiguous results interrupted; diagnostic reads remain available
Real process-group cancellation/drain, bounded time/output; no automatic install/upgrade retry or rollback claim
compatibilityDifferences: Parse actual package/archive records instead of unconditional upstream nonempty-lines[2:] dropping first package
retries defaults to 1 and accepts only 1, unlike upstream default 3 mutation attempts; all other values rejected before commands
Strict bare names only; max256 names each2-192 ASCII chars; version/arch/distribution selectors and trailing +/- action selectors unsupported, even when a trailing sign is a legal Debian name
No-match resolution returns without install; empty resolver avoids upstream unbounded empty regex
Dpkg noninteractive confdef/confold preserves prior config; query refresh atomically publishes only after all successful steps
notImplemented: PackageKit, public HTTP/RPC system wiring, process maintenance lease and service ownership transfer
Public journal clear/reconciliation; only trusted external reconciliation may clear persisted unknown intent
Real host package installation/upgrade, real sudo capability verification, service/target-board/device acceptance
Power loss, escaped/new-session processes and real package maintainer-script recovery guarantees
Exact installation for legal names ending +/- including common g++; naive + suffix rewriting was rejected by real collision solver evidence

selectorCollisionProbe.conditions: Early private APT_CONFIG dump has no host hooks; private synthetic local indexes; --simulate only; empty fixture dpkg status unchanged
selectorCollisionProbe.finding: Uniformly appending + is not exact: APT chooses a real package with the full appended name when one exists
selectorCollisionProbe.decision: Keep explicit trailing +/- unsupported; do not ship name rewriting. Immediate follow-up: trusted metadata-backed exact name=version or official exact patterns, including g++, with collision/no-removal validation.
